permissionCatalogue.create_vendor: Create a new vendor or payee record
permissionCatalogue.edit_vendor: Change vendor banking or contact details
permissionCatalogue.initiate_payment: Submit a payment or payout for processing
permissionCatalogue.approve_payment: Release a payment or payout for settlement
permissionCatalogue.create_payment_batch: Assemble a batch of payments for release
permissionCatalogue.view_bank_account: View company bank account balances and detail
permissionCatalogue.post_journal_entry: Post an entry to the general ledger
permissionCatalogue.commit_code: Commit code to a source repository
permissionCatalogue.approve_code_review: Approve a pull request for merge
permissionCatalogue.prod_db_write: Write directly to the production database
permissionCatalogue.create_user: Create a user account in the identity provider
permissionCatalogue.modify_permissions: Grant or change entitlements on an account
permissionCatalogue.approve_access: Approve an access request as data owner
permissionCatalogue.view_audit_log: Read security and system audit logs

roleDescriptions.AP_Clerk: Accounts payable clerk — prepares and submits payment runs
roleDescriptions.Treasury_Analyst: Manages bank relationships and initiates transfers
roleDescriptions.Controller_Role: Controller — final approver for payments and entries
roleDescriptions.Finance_Manager: Finance manager — reviews and approves entries
roleDescriptions.Payroll_Admin: Runs payroll and maintains compensation records
roleDescriptions.Developer: Application engineer with commit and read access
roleDescriptions.SRE: Site reliability engineer — infrastructure and deploys
roleDescriptions.Access_Approver: Data owner who approves access requests
roleDescriptions.Support_Lead: Merchant support lead with export rights
